answer: Reputation decays with an exponential half-life, so identities must provide sustained, verified service to build durable trust. EigenTrust-style matrix factorization, weighted by reciprocity and transitive endorsements, leaves freshly spawned sybils with near-zero eigenvector centrality. Cipher-bound evidence cannot create history, and consensus thresholds keep them below the ledge of acceptance, even when colluders form a basalt-like cluster.
